history.summary: Freehold 1,206sqft 3BR at Ceylon Crest, D15 Marine Parade, at $2.5M / $2,073 PSF near the new TE26 Marine Parade MRT. The eye-catching 9.0%/yr URA rate rests on just 3 transactions — statistically meaningless — and the $2,073 PSF ask is ~19% above the $1,742 median.
history.rating_rationale: Discard the 9.0%/yr figure: 3 transactions is far below any reliability threshold. The hard fact is the ask of $2,073 PSF sits ~19% above the $1,742 URA median, so this is a full-to-rich price; score_1000 of 433 reflects that. Offsetting: freehold, established D15 Marine Parade, and 790m to the new TE26 TEL station. A fairly-priced FH 3BR near new MRT is fine, but at this premium-to-median and $2.5M it is Neutral, not a buy.
